title: Client Services Daily Banking Ireland/UK
full_description:
Do you want to be a member of the team to make a meaningful impact?At ING, our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We believe that sustainable progress is driven by people with the imagination and determination to make a better future for themselves and those around them.ING is changing what banking can be. For you that means plenty of opportunities for personal growth in a continuously evolving dynamic environment. In return we ask for your long-term commitment and involvement.If this is the environment you thrive in, then apply and join us in changing the future of banking!Our department Client Services Daily Banking Ireland is responsible for daily support of our Irish corporate clients and their service portfolio in ING Bank Ireland. You’ll be working in an international team to support our clients with their payments related questions, accounts, different types of confirmations, statements, mandates and much more.Something for you? Be a part of an international changing environment where „Every day is a new day & new experience. “
